Container.Name: TravStats
Container.Overview:
TravStats - Personal Flight Tracking & Statistics Dashboard
Track your flights, visualize routes on an interactive world map, and unlock achievements as you explore the world.
✈ Features: - Interactive Leaflet map with flight paths and airport markers - Detailed airport statistics (visits, airlines, first/last visit) - 58 Battlefield-style achievements across 5 categories - Advanced statistics and analytics dashboard - Dark mode support with theme persistence - RESTful API with JWT authentication - Responsive mobile-friendly UI
⚠ REQUIREMENTS: This application requires a PostgreSQL database with PostGIS extension. See the support thread for detailed setup instructions.
First-time setup: 1. Install PostgreSQL container (postgis/postgis:15-3.4) named "travstats-db" 2. Configure database environment variables (see Requires section) 3. Install this container with matching database credentials 4. Access web UI and create your account
Container.Requires:
⚠ PostgreSQL 15 with PostGIS extension required!
STEP 1: Install PostgreSQL container first: - Search for "postgis/postgis" in Community Apps - Container Name: travstats-db - POSTGRES_DB: flights - POSTGRES_USER: flights - POSTGRES_PASSWORD: [choose-secure-password] - Port: 5432:5432 - Volume: /mnt/user/appdata/travstats-db:/var/lib/postgresql/data
STEP 2: Then install this TravStats container with: - DATABASE_URL matching your PostgreSQL credentials - Strong JWT_SECRET (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32)
See support thread for detailed installation guide.
Container.Changes: ### Version 1.0.0 (2025-01-21) - Initial release - Combined frontend + backend in single container - 58 achievements system - Interactive map with flight paths - Airport statistics and markers - Dark mode support - PostgreSQL with PostGIS backend - JWT authentication

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for accessing the web interface. Default: 3000

Config.Name: Database Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database password. Must match the POSTGRES_PASSWORD you set in the travstats-db container.

Config.Name: Database Host
Config.Description: PostgreSQL hostname. Use 'localhost' if using --network=container mode, or 'travstats-db' if using --link.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent storage for auto-generated JWT secret and app configuration

Config.Name: Seed Airports
Config.Description: Automatically populate airports database with ~8000 airports on first start. Recommended: true (takes 1-2 minutes on first boot)

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Node.js runtime environment. Leave as 'production' unless debugging.

Config.Name: Backend Port
Config.Description: Internal backend API port. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.
